violation_type.title: Responsibilities - Not delay or prevent inspection or investigation (26 TAC §745.8411(b)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities - Not delay or prevent inspection or investigation
violation_type.typical_finding: The van used for transportation was not made avalible for CCR staff upon request.

finding_variants.text: The van used for transportation was not made avalible for CCR staff upon request.
This standard was evaluated as part of a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient when a DFPS staff member was not granted access to operation staff to conduct interviews for over one hour.

The caregiver in charge was unable to give access to the rest of the building to inspected other classroom.       Corrected:  When the director made it to the operation and the inceptor was able to inspected the other classrooms.
The caregiver was in the home and refused to open the door for approxiametly 40 minutes.

I was not able to conduct an inspection because there was not someone available to open the front door.  Also, the doorbell was not functioning because of Wi-Fi issues due to the weather. The doorbell alerts staff that someone is at the front door. Front door is kept locked and the only way you can enter the operation is by having someone open the door from the inside or by having a key to get inside. The operation's business phone is transferred to someone who is not at the operation. Upon calling that number, that individual wasn't successful in making contact with staff at the operation.

Primary caregiver stated that children were present and being sent home due to no electricity when licensing attempted inspection on 7/16/25. Licensing was not allowed entrance on 7/16/25 to conduct inspection.
